name: Avoid sending mail
description: Suppresses outgoing email to a configured blocklist of addresses via hook_mail_alter().
project_description: Avoid sending mail (asm) suppresses outbound email addressed to a configured list of blocked addresses. It defines an 'asm_email_blocked' content entity holding the blocked addresses, and implements hook_mail_alter() to strip those addresses from a message's To/Cc/Bcc headers (cancelling the send entirely when every To recipient is blocked). A hook_asm_send_mail_email_blocked_alter() alter hook lets other modules force-send to an otherwise-blocked address. The optional asm_ui submodule adds the admin listing and add/edit/delete forms for the blocklist.
